who is Helen?

Meet Helen, artist & teacher

Helen Hyland is an Irish artist who loves to create, always has and always will. Alongside her own work in watercolour, pen and chalk pastel, the heart of her business is sharing her passion for painting, pastel art, printmaking, sculpture and paper crafts.

"Kids naturally love art. The chats, laughing, singing and general feel good vibe is pure joy." Her classes build creative thinking, motor skills, confidence and friendships, with a close weekly following and a personal experience for every child.

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the questions people ask most. Can't see yours? Call +353 86 813 2216 or send an enquiry.

What ages are the kids classes for?

Saturday classes and workshops suit ages 7 to 12. The Thursday after school class is for 1st to 6th Class.

Does my child need any art experience?

No. Classes are open to any skill level and led in a fun, engaging way, so kids can explore their creativity and build real skills.

What materials do the kids use?

Each term has a new seasonal theme using acrylic paint, watercolours, chalk and oil pastels, clay sculpture, collage, charcoal and pencil.

How do I get a place?

There's a waiting list for all Saturday classes. Send an enquiry and Helen will add you to the list for the next term.

Is there anything my child should know before starting?

Because of the activities, children should be comfortable using scissors, needles and a hot glue gun.

I've never painted. Can I join an adult workshop?

Yes. No experience is necessary. Helen guides you every step of the way and everyone works at their own pace.
